info.text:
Freezing your credit doesn't cost you a single point.
The FTC and CFPB both say a credit freeze doesn't affect your credit score.
Since September 2018 it's free by federal law; online or phone lifts must happen within 1 hour.
A freeze doesn't stop fraud on existing cards, and the FTC got 1.1M+ identity theft reports in 2024.
Sources: FTC, CFPB, Economic Growth, Regulatory Relief, and Consumer Protection Act (2018), FTC Consumer Sentinel.
News and education, not financial advice.
